subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: GraphQL-Specific Testing
description: Learn GraphQL-Specific Testing in one minute.

hook.text: A GraphQL query asks for users, their orders, their reviews, and their friends—all in one request. The server chokes.

buildup.text: GraphQL's flexibility lets clients request anything. Without limits, a single query can overwhelm the server.

discovery.text: Testing covers query depth limits, complexity scores, and responses to deeply nested or circular queries.

twist.text: Unlike REST, GraphQL always returns 200. Errors hide inside the response body, not the status code.

climax.text: Depth-limit tests confirm that queries beyond level 5 are rejected. The server stays protected.

punchline.text: GraphQL is powerful. Test the limits of that power.

quiz.question: What unique risk does GraphQL have?
options: Deeply nested queries can overwhelm the server
